title: Pocket Fuel Lemon & Papaya Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Lemon Papaya from Pocket Fuel delivers a perfect balance of sharp, zingy citrus and the smooth tropical sweetness of Papaya for a vape that’s fresh, zesty and deliciously exotic. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered mods and sub-ohm tanks .
